label_summary.labeling: Individual model review; conservative GENUINE for uncertainty; historical alternative accepted when question has no time constraint. Not independent human validation.

limitations: Original scorer is primary; numeric_v2 rescoring checks only composed predictions. Single-hop predictions are not saved in eval files, so new single-hop accuracies/gaps cannot be reconstructed here.
t95 over 3 seeds uses Student t df=2 normality assumption; not population/task uncertainty. No pooling repeated seed predictions as independent observations.
Per-run McNemar p values are unadjusted; many comparisons.
Gold and hops eval files from previous experiments remain missing.
New keep-all seed0 is 53.2%, whereas handoff reported 54.2%; cause unknown, do not merge runs.
Exp8 logit lens uses original exp6 logic, without explicitly filtering bridge/final token overlap; avoid treating as clean mechanism verification.
Three-seed t intervals assume normal seed effects; do not quantify task sampling uncertainty.
Per-seed McNemar p values are unadjusted; repeated seeds are not pooled as independent items.
No significant difference is not equivalence. No predeclared equivalence margin, so no equivalence claim.
Shuffled labels can remain correct or unchanged; use assignment diagnostics.
Category matching does not establish a unique internal mechanism.
Gold selects subsets and constrains shuffled targets; this is not gold-free training allocation.
Correct and wrong groups contain different questions; category matching does not match difficulty or person distribution.
Self-output correspondence is not direct evidence of internal beliefs.
Only three seeds; t intervals assume normally distributed seed effects.
Failure to reject a difference does not prove equivalence or no forgetting.
Matching is randomized but not uniform over all valid permutations.
Legacy/truncate are rescoring sensitivity analyses; allocation always used floor.
